case_title: CHRISTINE BEATLESTON VS. EXTRANOMICAL TOURS, LLC

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-27-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO OCT-15-2021 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF CHRISTINE BEATLESTON IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT EXTRANOMICAL TOURS, LLC, REPRESENTED BY GARY LILLIAN, PRESIDENT IS PRESENT. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. COURT DETERMINES THAT PARTIES ARE REQUIRED TO GO TO ARBITRATION, PURSUANT TO THE ARBITRATION AGREEMENT THAT WAS SIGNED BY ALL PARTIES. PARTIES ARE TO USE THE AMERICAN ARBITRATION ASSOCIATION FOR ARBITRATION. A PROGRESS REPORT DATE IS SET TO PROVIDE THE STATUS OF ARBITRATION EFFORTS. A CONCERTED EFFORT BY ALL PARTIES TOWARDS ARBITRATION MUST BE SHOWN. APPEARANCES ARE REQUIRED. ZOOM APPEARANCE IS APPROVED FOR ALL PARTIES. FAILURE TO SHOW GOOD FAITH EFFORTS TO ARBITRATION WILL RESULT IN PUNITIVE DAMAGES. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. THE COURT FINDS THAT A DISMISSAL WITHOUT PREJUDICE IS APPROPRIATE UNTIL OTHERWISE FILED BY PLAINTIFF. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
